Products

Product paths built around a single interaction engine.

The product layer is structured for both direct use and integration, while the visual system stays aligned with the same dark, sharp, technical character across the site.

Product 1

A standalone application package for teams that want an immediate gesture-control layer without managing extra hardware complexity.

  • Freemium and full versions planned.
  • Focused on fast onboarding and clear configuration.
  • Designed to drop into modern workstation setups.

Product 2

An SDK and integration path for partners who want to embed Gesleap interaction into their own products and experiences.

  • Built for tailored application behavior.
  • Supports product-specific command mapping.
  • Fits OEM and custom software workflows.

GESLEAP

Architecting gesture-first control systems with software and hardware integration that stays exact, calm, and production-ready.
